Design and demonstration notes

Privacy-Aware Intelligent Smart IoT System

A complete interactive project that demonstrates secure environmental sensing, cloud preprocessing and machine-learning decision support using synthetic streaming telemetry.

Problem

Safe sensing without unnecessary collection

Smart buildings benefit from environmental data, but the system should not retain personal identity, exact location or unused metadata to make a ventilation decision.

Solution

Edge to cloud privacy pipeline

The gateway verifies device identity, minimises the message, pseudonymises the session, derives features and passes them to the anomaly model and policy engine.

Architecture
1. Edge sensing
Temperature, humidity, CO2 and light sensors capture environmental values.
2. Secure gateway
Mutual TLS, certificate validation, message schema check and topic authorisation.
3. Privacy filter
Remove precise location and persistent identifier; retain an approved zone and pseudonymous session.
4. Cloud analytics
Clean values, create rolling features, compute anomaly score and record quality.
5. Decision and audit
Combine model score with policy. Provide recommendation, human override and a minimal audit trail.
How to demonstrate

Suggested presentation flow

  1. Open Operations Lab and start the normal stream.
  2. Explain the digital twin, secure packets, privacy score and pseudonymous telemetry table.
  3. Select Poor air quality event to demonstrate a CO2 alert and fresh-air recommendation.
  4. Open Analytics Centre to show the feature and anomaly score streams.
  5. Open Security Centre to explain mTLS, policy controls, device registry and security audit events.

Note: all streams are synthetic and run in the browser. This is a prototype demonstration, not a real building control system.
